description: No time limit is shown anywhere before the request expires: the terminal prints 'Waiting for approval...' and the page says 'the request expires on its own'. Users do not know they have 10 minutes.
expected: 'This code works for 10 minutes' on the CLI and page.
suggested_fix: Print 'Expires in 10 minutes' in the login output and on the card.

description: A stale pairing card (opened before expiry) still shows Approve after expiry; clicking it gives an inline error but the card keeps looking actionable, and the error text shows literal backticks around `agent-drive login`, unlike the code-styled version on the No pairing card.
expected: Card flips to the 'No pairing/expired' state, or Approve is disabled; consistent code styling.
actual: Inline alert 'This request expired or was already used. Run `agent-drive login` in your agent to get a new code.'
suggested_fix: Render the command as code and replace the card state on a 404/410 response.

description: Manual code entry rejects a well-formed-looking code (ABCD-EFGH) with 'Enter the code in the form XXXX-XXXX.' without saying codes use only certain letters.
expected: Tell the user to copy the code exactly as printed.
actual: Format message for a code that already has the XXXX-XXXX shape.
suggested_fix: Reword: 'That is not a valid code. Copy it from your terminal.'

description: One message ('wrong, expired, or already used') covers three distinct states, so a user who approved the right code earlier cannot tell that it succeeded.
expected: If already approved: 'This code was already approved.'
actual: Same text for approved MHZL-CQMP and unknown BCDF-GHJK.
suggested_fix: Distinguish used vs expired vs unknown.
